headline: Late-Night Flurry in Godcrofts and Farranac Coast
war_summary: Since the last edition, Godcrofts has flared anew, recording five strategic-base events in the final two hours, with Lipsia the busiest point at twelve daily events. Farranac Coast remains hot, adding three more events in the last two hours; Mara, Scythe, and Terra are each at five for the day. DeadLands has stirred from its earlier lull, The Salt March showing seven daily events and three in the closing two hours. Fishermans Row, so active at the prior cutoff, has been quiet since 22:10 though its daily count still stands at eleven. Tempest Island has not logged a strategic-base event since 18:36, and Lykos Isle, once the day's busiest front with twenty-two events, has been silent for hours. Stlican Shelf latest came at 18:52. Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow remain heavy casualty fronts without fresh flips. The one hundred fourth day ends with neither side holding the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest.
